info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Loyalty Loyalty Partners-v4-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Partners Listing API provides businesses with a comprehensive view of available loyalty partners. This endpoint allows users to query and retrieve precise information about various loyalty partners affiliated with a loyalty program. It is primarily targeted at developers and business analysts looking to integrate loyalty options into consumer applications or to analyze partnership opportunities. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance customer engagement through tailored loyalty initiatives.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of loyalty partners.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all loyalty partners available in the system. Use this to display or utilize the loyalty partner information in various applications.
